paragraphs: The 730d and 740d form the diesel backbone of the G11/G12 7 Series generation, produced from 2015 to 2022. Both variants use the B57 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel that replaced the earlier N57 engine in BMW's diesel range. The B57 is widely regarded as a reliable and refined unit, forming part of BMW's modular B-series engine family that also includes the petrol B58. The 730d and 740d are essentially different power outputs of the same engine — sharing the same B57 architecture — with the 740d offering a higher state of tune. The 730d/740d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
